run_BriaFiboPipeline_call: run the BriaFiboPipeline to generate images from a text prompt using classifier-free guidance
create_BriaFiboPipeline_encode_prompt: create prompt embeddings from text using the encode_prompt method with guidance scale
build_BriaFiboPipeline_get_prompt_embeds: build tokenized prompt embeddings with hidden states using get_prompt_embeds for the text encoder
test_BriaFiboPipeline_prepare_latents: test the prepare_latents method to initialize random latent tensors with optional patching
review_BriaFiboPipeline_check_inputs: review the check_inputs method to validate prompt height width and embedding arguments
